description: Land Acquisition - Pitipana-North, Hoomagama D/S Division, Colombo District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 2145/25, Thihagoda D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (including lot numbers, descriptions, extents, and claimant information) for public purposes. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative procedures, including acquisition notices, descriptions of properties to be acquired, and compensation claims processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
